           CASE WHEN home_team_goal > away_team_goal THEN 'Win' ELSE 'Loss' END AS outcome,

               home_player_9, home_player_10, home_player_11
           ) AS lineup
    FROM main."Match"
    WHERE home_team_goal <> away_team_goal

    UNION ALL

    SELECT id AS match_id,
           CASE WHEN away_team_goal > home_team_goal THEN 'Win' ELSE 'Loss' END AS outcome,
           json_array(
               away_player_1, away_player_2, away_player_3, away_player_4,
               away_player_5, away_player_6, away_player_7, away_player_8,
               away_player_9, away_player_10, away_player_11
           ) AS lineup
    FROM main."Match"
    WHERE home_team_goal <> away_team_goal
),
player_totals AS (
    SELECT t.outcome,
           slot.value AS player_api_id,
           COUNT(DISTINCT t.match_id) AS match_count
    FROM team_lineups AS t
    CROSS JOIN json_each(t.lineup) AS slot
    WHERE slot.value IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY t.outcome, slot.value
),
ranked AS (

           home_team_goal > away_team_goal AS won,

    WHERE home_team_goal <> away_team_goal
    UNION ALL
    SELECT id AS match_id,
           away_team_goal > home_team_goal AS won,
           json_array(
               away_player_1, away_player_2, away_player_3, away_player_4,
               away_player_5, away_player_6, away_player_7, away_player_8,
               away_player_9, away_player_10, away_player_11
           ) AS players
    FROM main."Match"
    WHERE home_team_goal <> away_team_goal
), slots AS (
    SELECT l.match_id, l.won, j.value AS player_api_id
    FROM lineups AS l
    CROSS JOIN json_each(l.players) AS j
), player_matches AS (
    SELECT match_id, player_api_id,
           COUNT(*) AS slot_count,
           COUNT(DISTINCT won) AS outcome_count
    FROM slots
    WHERE player_api_id IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY match_id, player_api_id
)

    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM main."Match" WHERE home_team_goal = away_team_goal) AS draws,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM main."Match"

    (SELECT COUNT(*) - COUNT(match_api_id) FROM main."Match") AS missing_match_ids,
    (SELECT COUNT(match_api_id) - COUNT(DISTINCT match_api_id) FROM main."Match") AS duplicate_match_ids,

    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM slots WHERE player_api_id IS NULL) AS null_slots,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM player_matches WHERE slot_count > outcome_count) AS repeated_same_side,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM player_matches WHERE outcome_count > 1) AS listed_on_both_sides,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM player_matches AS a
